concerns.text: The specification computes the mean embedding vector using the embedding matrix multiplication $W_E \times f$ (FR-005), whereas the original idea proposes using the pseudo‑inverse of the unembedding matrix $W_U$ to obtain the average token embedding. This methodological change alters the definition of the measured “mean embedding” and may no longer validly test whether the edge‑spectrum subspace encodes a universal prior, constituting a drift from the research question.
